verdict.summary: The requested non-tone-affecting amp/cab safety hardening is implemented and validated.

fixedFindings.title: Oversized-block guard before oversampler.processSamplesUp
fixedFindings.implementation: Prepared block capacity is stored during prepareToPlay and checked before JUCE Oversampling. Oversized blocks use a finite dry fallback through the existing bypass wrapper with no allocation or resize in processBlock.

fixedFindings.title: NaN/Inf scrub and state recovery
fixedFindings.implementation: Invalid input samples are replaced with 0.0f before stateful DSP. Sag, cathode, touch, and HighGainAmp gate/envelope state are sanitized before update so invalid values cannot latch.

fixedFindings.title: Missing ScopedNoDenormals in amp/cab processBlock
fixedFindings.implementation: juce::ScopedNoDenormals is created at the top of each requested processBlock entry.
